No hiring option can be put forward yet: the model could not test the **annual salary spend ≤ £400k/year** limit, so that central constraint was excluded from the comparison.

- The comparison is **fragile** and rests on six Olumi-supplied estimates, not user evidence. The most sensitive assumption is **delivery capacity**; it is an Olumi estimate, and changing it can alter the ordering.
- The analysis also assumed that more platform-delivery progress is better; that objective direction was not stated by you.
- The £400k limit cannot be checked in this model yet.
